closing_words:
Most of the matches are in memory, but the Docshelf results for CL-04, CL-10 and CL-11 were cut off. I'm recalling them in full before I file anything.

I'm in Primeline and the checklist I read earlier already settles CL-11. It is the "Affidavit of payment of debts and claims, Brookhollow", so DS-25 answers it. I'm filing 10 attach cards, one per document. CL-06 needs two because there are two serial numbers. Nothing is sent until you answer each card.


**What I left alone, and why**
- **CL-05 (surety consent) and CL-09 (HVAC training record):** Primeline already accepted them, on 1 Oct and 5 Oct, so I didn't resend DS-22 or DS-28.
- **DS-09, DS-13 and PS-W1:** These are progress waivers. They only release payments up to their dates, so they don't answer a final-waiver item.
- **DS-19:** This is the certificate that expired on 30 June 2026. It is the one Primeline rejected.
- **DS-30:*

trace.user: Primeline won't release our $48,600 retainage on Harbor Point until the closeout package is complete. Start here: read the terms on final payment, waivers, insurance and warranties, and our closeout checklist.
trace.said: Reading the four term topics and the checklist now.

Nine of the 11 checklist items still need a document, and CL-05 and CL-09 are accepted and stay as they are. I'm listing what each of the five systems holds so I can match documents to items.


**Plan**
- CL-01, CL-04, CL-10 and CL-11 come from Docshelf. CL-02 may also be there.
- CL-03 comes from Partsmith. I need a final conditional waiver, not a progress waiver.
- CL-06 comes from the Partsmith warranty registrations. I'll match them by serial number and owner.

trace.user: Now Sitegrid: the closeout spec sections, our submittals and startup reports, and the record drawings we uploaded.
trace.said: One sentence: I'm reading Sitegrid's spec sections, submittals and record drawing sets now, read-only.

Sitegrid is read, and it settles CL-08 and the identity of the faucets and rooftop units.

- **CL-08, record drawings:** RD-M3 is the one to send. It is the final set, issued for record 5 Oct 2026 and signed by A. Castellanos, as spec 01 78 39 requires. RD-M2 is an unsigned field markup with three sheets still to update, so it doesn't answer the item.
- **CL-07, faucet manual:** The approved submittal SB-22-04 substituted Fixturely FX-3100 for the scheduled FX-3000, and all 18 installed faucets are FX-3100.

trace.user: This is Partsmith. Their lien waivers to us and the warranty registrations they filed.
trace.said: Reading both Partsmith lists now, read-only.

Partsmith settles CL-03 and CL-06. I haven't attached anything yet, because the attach tool belongs to the Primeline tab.

- **CL-03:** Send PS-W2, the conditional waiver and release on final payment. It is dated 6 Oct 2026, covers all materials furnished, and has a final amount of $6,240.00. Don't send PS-W1. It is a progress waiver through 31 Aug and doesn't answer a final-waiver item.
- **CL-06:** Send PS-WR-0871 (serial 4C21-0871, RTU-1) and PS-WR-0874 (serial 4C21-0874, RTU-2).
I'm reading Fixturely's manual list now. It's read-only, and I'm looking for the FX-3100 manual that CL-07 needs.

Fixturely settles CL-07: attach FX-M3100. I haven't attached anything yet, because the attach tool belongs to the Primeline tab.

- **CL-07:** Send FX-M3100, the operation and maintenance manual for the FX-3100 lavatory faucet. Sitegrid's approved submittal SB-22-04 substituted the FX-3100 for the scheduled FX-3000, and all 18 installed faucets are FX-3100.

trace.user: And our Docshelf: our own waivers, the insurance certificates, the surety consent, the affidavit, training and attic stock records.
trace.said: Reading Docshelf's documents now. It's read-only, and it covers CL-01, 02, 04, 10 and 11.
Page 1 of Docshelf is read. I'm reading page 2 for the affidavit, training and attic stock records.

Docshelf settles CL-01, CL-02, CL-04, CL-10 and CL-11. I've attached nothing yet, because the attach op belongs to the Primeline tab.


- **CL-01:** Send DS-11, our conditional waiver and release on final payment, dated 7 Oct for $48,600. Don't send DS-09, which is a progress waiver.
- **CL-02:** Send DS-14, Coldline's conditional final waiver, dated 6 Oct for $4,950. Don't send DS-13, which is a progress waiver.
- **CL-04:** Send DS-20.
